text:
nate: Ran a preview for shifting 25% to model-X on /chat/completions. Quick estimate shows +9% cost but staging replay is +0.8%.
bella: Fast estimator ignores prefix cache and coalescing. We need to surface both quick and replay numbers.
pete: Proposal: /v1/preview returns {preview_job_id, quick_estimate} immediately, then posts final result to /v1/preview/{id}/status when replay finishes. Include replay_trace_id and cohort_hash_version.
ux-zoe: UX: show "Quick (fast)" and "Final (replay)" side-by-side with a tooltip "why they differ" and a spinner for final. Also put Ops guidance card with suggested telemetry bump commands.
nate: Also include per-model quota headroom and a risk tag if headroom<10%.
infra-bot: preview-bot: job 1799999999 queued. ETA ~20s.
bella: Add a field `telemetry_recommendations` to promote response with actions like {trace_rate: "10%", p99_sampling: "increase 1%->20%", ops_playbook: "url"}.
pete: I'll wire deterministic trace_window selection using preview_job_id so replay is reproducible.
ux-zoe: Action items: pete implement job lifecycle + trace id, bella add quota fields and telemetry_recs, ux-zoe mock UI.
infra-bot: preview-bot: job 1799999999 completed. final_estimate: +0.8% (ci -0.4..+2.2), replay_trace_id=rt-2026-11-25-1799."
